title: I Gave the Choosing Beggar the Free Couch Photos and Nothing Else

parts.text: I sent her the listing photos again and stopped offering my elevator time. I am thirty-eight, tired dad, beige couch, Mateo eating cereal from a measuring cup again. Kendra wanted me to carry it down, hold it 4 days, steam-clean it, and throw in pillows. It was free. The listing said curb, Sunday, 2 p.m. She arrived Monday with no truck. I said the listing. She said I was unkind to a mother. I am a father with a measuring cup. A student named Sam took it Sunday with straps, as listed. Kendra wrote a novel in messages. I replied with the original post, screenshot, timestamp. Then I muted. The living room looked huge and guilty, then fine. Mateo did a sock slide. Free is a price that includes zero movers. I still have the pillows because they were never listed. That is how objects keep their names. Kendra said, "You could at least help load" I said, "The post said curb Sunday" Todd messaged sorry later. I reacted with a thumbs up and no text. I can still name the ugly little detail, which is how I know it happened. I noticed a scuff on the floor shaped like a comma, which fit i. Someone had left a receipt in the cup holder, faded blue ink.

social.video_title: I gave the free couch to the Sunday straps crew
social.description: Measuring-cup cereal, Monday with no truck, pillows unlisted. Free includes zero movers. Would you have steamed it for her?
